weather_report:
Subiaco is heading into a clear, bright evening, with only a few clouds expected later. The forecast gives no UV reading, but the late-afternoon sun can still be sharp, so sunglasses and sunscreen are sensible until it fades. It looks like a pleasant, open sort of day, with little to spoil a walk or the last errands before dusk.

A light shirt or dress should feel comfortable, with a thin layer handy as the air cools. This would be a good hour to take the longer route home, pick up a few groceries, or sit outside with a drink and let the brightness soften.
